comment: Pulled a genuine 142 kW on the main unit — 20 to 80 percent in just under half an hour. Attendant helped me line up the cable. Easily the best hub in Lahore right now.
Charged here twice last week. Covered bays make a real difference in July heat, and the lounge Wi-Fi actually works. Card payment went through on the first try.
The 150 kW unit is properly liquid-cooled, so it holds power instead of tapering at 40 percent like most sites here. Ioniq 5 hit peak within a minute of plugging in.
No complaints about the charging itself. Only note is that the 60 kW unit is almost always occupied in the evenings, so aim for the main bay or come before 6pm.
Stopped here on the way back from Islamabad with 8 percent left. Plugged in, had dinner upstairs, came back to 82 percent. Tariff is fair for the speed you get.
My default top-up spot in Islamabad. The DC unit is reliable and I have never had to queue on a weekday morning. Billing receipt comes by SMS straight away.
Good location if you are heading out toward Srinagar Highway. Two AC bays mean you can almost always plug in even when the fast charger is busy.
Charging is solid but the bays are tight for a longer car and the cable barely reaches if you park nose-in. Reverse in and you will be fine.
Reliable and clean, though it caps around 105 kW rather than the advertised 120. Still gets me to 80 percent in about 35 minutes, which is fine for a market stop.
Does the job but 50 kW feels slow now that faster sites are opening. Expect 55 to 60 minutes for a proper top-up. Location and parking are convenient though.
One of the two ports has been out of service for a couple of weeks, so plan for a wait in the evening. When it works, billing and speed are exactly as advertised.
Perfect for a small battery like the Lumin — 50 kW is more than my car can take anyway. Attendant is helpful and the site feels safe after dark.
Exactly what a destination charger should be. Leave the car on 22 kW, go do your shopping, come back with 40 percent more. Cheapest per-kWh rate I have found in Lahore.
Great for a plug-in hybrid — full charge in about two hours while I was at lunch nearby. Three bays means I have never seen it completely full.
Do not come here if you are in a hurry — it is AC only, so a 20 to 80 percent run takes the better part of three hours. Priced accordingly and well maintained.
Was a genuinely fast site before it went down — 130 kW sustained on my Seal. Currently offline for a transformer upgrade, so check the app before driving over.
Turned up on a Sunday with both bays dead and no notice on site. Staff at the plaza confirmed it has been down for a few weeks. Please update the status board.
Excellent location right on Jinnah Avenue and the hardware is good quality. Docking a star only for the current outage — worth revisiting once it is back.
The only reliable public CHAdeMO in the city. As a Leaf owner this station is the reason long trips inside Karachi are practical at all. Never found it broken.
Six ports across three standards means zero waiting, even at peak. Dedicated bays are actually enforced by security so you never find a petrol car parked in one.
Consistent 115 kW on the CCS2 side and the site is spotless. Cafés next door make the 25 minute stop painless. Best charging experience in Karachi by a wide margin.
Well lit, staffed around the clock and the app shows live port availability that actually matches reality. Slightly pricier per unit but worth it for the reliability.
Hard to fault the hardware or the service. Only reason for four stars is the tariff — about 10 rupees a unit more than Clifton, which adds up on a full charge.
